simple.meaning: חֲצִי הַמְּנַחְתִּי (Chătsîy ham-Mᵉnachtîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Chatsi-ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
